message.content: {"action":"change_interpolation","reason":"Switching interpolation is the only remaining legal move with an unvisited neighbor besides switch_architecture and decrease_precision. Current best balance is the 16-bit linear LUT (SQNR 82.1 dB, 1584.6 um²); changing interpolation explores a distinct accuracy/area tradeoff without pushing precision further into higher area or reducing it toward worse SQNR."}
